description:
List credit activity

Returns one page of how the selected organization's credit balance changed, newest first: credit notes issued and credit granted, credit applied to invoices, credit restored when the change an invoice paid for never applied, and credit voided. Each entry names the credit note (none for granted credit), the invoice when there is one, and the charge and subscription the credit note credits, or that the credit was a grant. Pass nextPage as page to read further. This operation does not change billing.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/organization-billing/list-credit-activity

page.description: Page to read, from 1: the nextPage of the page before.

name: listCreditActivity

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description: One change to the organization's credit balance, on a credit note or granted.

amountCents.description: How much the balance moved, in cents; kind says which way.

balanceAfterCents.description: The organization's credit balance once this entry applied, in cents.

creditNote.description: The credit note whose credit moved. Null for granted credit.

invoice.description: The invoice credit was applied to or restored from. Null otherwise.

source.description: Why the credit was issued: from the charge a credit note credits, or a grant. Null when it is neither: a credit note that credits no charge, or wallet credit an invoice used or that was voided.

walletTransaction.description: The wallet transaction that moved granted credit. Null for a credit note, and when ending the wallet voided what it had left.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description:
Enum descriptions: {"applied":"Credit paid part of an invoice.","issued":"A credit note or a grant added credit.","restored":"Credit an invoice used came back because the change it paid for never applied.","voided":"What a credit note or granted credit had left was voided."}

Known values: ["issued","applied","restored","voided"]. Others may be added.

chargeCode.description: The fixed-charge code for a release, the plan code for a plan change. Null for a grant.

description.description: What Photon called a grant when it granted it, such as "Welcome credit". Null for a credit note, and for a grant without one.

subject.description: Whose subscription the charge was on: the organization's own, or a project's. Null when it is none Billing knows.

success_200_6170706c69636174696f6e2f6a73.description:
Enum descriptions: {"grant":"Credit Photon granted the organization, such as a new account's first organization's welcome credit.","other":"Any other credit note.","release":"Released units of a prorated fixed charge: their unused days.","unused_time":"A plan's base fee: the unused time after an upgrade or termination."}

Known values: ["release","unused_time","other","grant"]. Others may be added.

nextPage.description: Pass as page to read the next page. Null on the last page.

title: List credit activity
